repairs.title: Screens and glass
repairs.notice: The screen or the glass over it is cracked or shattered, on a phone or a tablet.
repairs.fix: A new screen or new glass goes in.

repairs.title: Weak batteries
repairs.notice: The charge disappears fast, the phone cuts out before it reaches zero, or the battery has started to swell.

repairs.title: Won't charge
repairs.notice: Nothing happens when you plug it in, or it charges only when the cable is wedged at an angle.
repairs.fix: We find what is stopping the charge and repair it.

repairs.title: Lens and back damage
repairs.notice: Photos coming out blurry, a lens with a crack in it, or a back panel that's smashed.
repairs.fix: The damaged lens or back panel is replaced.

repairs.title: Sound problems
repairs.notice: Calls sound muffled, or the speaker or microphone has gone quiet.
repairs.fix: We repair the speaker or the microphone.

repairs.title: A wet phone
repairs.notice: It went in the sink, the rain or a drink. Power it off straight away and get it to us quickly.
repairs.fix: We check what the water reached, then tell you what can be saved and what it costs.
